name: Intra Position Movement Query V 01
definition: The IntraPositionMovementQuery message is sent from an account owner/requestor to a settlement infrastructure to query intra-position movement instructions, along with their current status, based on a set of search criteria.|The message may also be used to: |- re-send a message sent by the account owner to the account servicer (the sub-function of the message is "Duplicate") |- provide a third party with a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy") |- re-send to a third party a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy Duplicate").

QueryDefinition.name: Query Definition
QueryDefinition.definition: Defines the intra-position movement instruction query criteria.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
